name: Funmilayo Ransome-Kuti
role: educator, women's rights leader, anti-colonial organiser

sources.claim: Led the Abeokuta Women's Union and the campaign that deposed the Alake over colonial taxation.
sources.source: Cheryl Johnson-Odim and Nina Emma Mba, For Women and the Nation: Funmilayo Ransome-Kuti of Nigeria (University of Illinois Press, 1997)

sources.claim: Mother of Fela, Beko, Olikoye, and Dolupo Ransome-Kuti.

sources.claim: Born Frances Abigail Olufunmilayo Thomas, 25 October 1900, Abeokuta; died 13 April 1978.
